confirmedNewBugs.title: Mind-map connect-drag lacks the same-node and same-direction guards that the file-map connect path has: dropping a connect-drag back on the same node creates a self-loop edge, and repeating a connect-drag between two already-connected nodes creates additional parallel duplicate edges (same direction) that persist across save/reload
confirmedNewBugs.feature: F06 edges/connections (authored mind map); contrast: F05 file-map connect is guarded
repro: 1. Create/open a Mind map document (sidebar New > Mind map). Select central node, ribbon '+ Comment' not needed; use node's right 'Connect node <name>' port.
2. Drag from the port and drop on ANOTHER node that is already connected to the source (or drag and drop back onto the SAME node).

3. Observed: a NEW edge is pushed every time. Verified via __np3.doc().writer.map: two edges Central->Kid (fromSide left, toSide right AND toSide left) after one repeat; and one self-loop Central->Central after same-node drop.
4. Edges persist across save/reload (data-level, read from writer.map after reload of earlier state).
confirmedNewBugs.expected: Connecting two already-connected nodes (same direction) is a no-op, and a node cannot connect to itself — exactly the behavior implemented one layer away in connectFileMapNodes.
confirmedNewBugs.observed: Unconditional edges.push in the mind-map drag end handler; N repeats create N parallel edges; self-loops allowed.
controls: File-map connect (connectFileMapNodes override, app-js extract L1308): guards from.id===to.id AND same-direction duplicate (library.map.links.some(from,to) -> return). Sibling layer proves the intended contract.
Map undo (Ctrl+Z x2): cleanly removed both test edges (3->1, selfLoops 0) — undo integration intact (predicate pass).
confirmedNewBugs.sourceMechanism: mapSurface pointerdown 'end' handler (app-js.txt extract L1269, original ~L4837): mapChanged(()=>{...mapData().edges.push({id:uid('edge'),from:id,to:target.id,fromSide,toSide})}) — no from===to check, no existing-edge check. Contrast: connectFileMapNodes (extract L1308) has both guards for the file-map layer.
confirmedNewBugs.impact: Visual clutter + ambiguous graph data; duplicates accumulate silently with repeated drags; deletion/undo ambiguity (which parallel edge is removed); self-loops render as degenerate curves. Data-integrity hygiene issue in the authored graph.
confirmedNewBugs.fixDirection: In the drag end handler, early-return when target.id===id and when an edge with same from&&to (either direction, or same direction to match file-map semantics) already exists.
